Cleaned 7/29/26: source MultiPolygon had 40 parts - the main 1998.6 km2 district plus one 5.65 km2 secondary piece, and 38 tiny sliver fragments (0.67 km2 down to sub-hectare specks), mostly hugging river/stream corridors (district boundaries are commonly drawn along stream centerlines, and digitizing slivers accumulate along those same lines) - rendered as scattered artifacts on the map. Dropped anything under 1.0 km2 as likely digitizing noise, kept the two significant pieces. Still pending a sanity-check with the district itself (state-maintained special-district data can trace back to old scanned drawings).
